items.headline: NFL Week 4 uniforms: Browns wearing 'Alpha Dawg' look; Giants go 'Legacy'
items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 4, led by an alternate look from the Cleveland Browns.

items.headline: Jalen Hurts challenges underdog Eagles to find out who they are ahead of matchup with Rams
items.description: — Jalen Hurts isn't used to losing much with the Philadelphia Eagles — only 16 times since 2022 — and he certainly isn't used to getting embarrassed.

items.headline: Puka Nacua expects to play against the Eagles
items.description: Sarah Barshop reports on Puka Nacua expecting to come back from his groin injury to play in Week 4 vs. the Eagles.

items.headline: Why Matthew Stafford made a cameo in Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' music video
items.description: Why, yes, that was Matthew Stafford. Here's why all signs pointed to the reigning NFL MVP's music video cameo.

items.headline: NFL tells Rams DPI shouldn't have been called on Josh Wallace
items.description: Sarah Barshop reports on the NFL telling the Rams that defensive pass interference shouldn't have been called on Josh Wallace at the end of the Rams' loss to the Broncos.

items.headline: Sean McVay: NFL told Rams DPI shouldn't have been called
items.description: Rams head coach Sean McVay says the NFL told the team that defensive pass interference should not have been called against cornerback Josh Wallace in Sunday night's loss to the Broncos.
